test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"testament."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Testament" **means a statement of belief or a person's last will and testament. (किसी बात के अस्तित्व में होने या सच होने का प्रमाण) • **Example**: *The detail of her wildlife paintings is a **testament__** to her powers of observation.* • In this context, it refers to a statement or declaration that fills in the blank. • Grammatically**, "testament"** is a noun and fits appropriately in the sentence structure. • The correct answer is Option 4. • **Correct passage**: .........The craftsmanship and attention to detail in these coins are a __**testament**__ to the skill and creativity of ancient artists....... [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "refusal",** means the act of declining or rejecting something. ((किसी बात को मानने, काम को करने से) इनकार करने की क्रिया; इनकार) • **Option 2, "commitment", **means a promise or dedication to a particular cause or action. (किसी उचित या महत्वपूर्ण लगने वाले कार्य के प्रति संलग्‍नता; प्रतिबद्घता) • **Option 3, "confusion",** means a state of uncertainty or lack of understanding. (उलझन, घबराहट, भ्रम, किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ता) 4c:Td95, The correct answer is** "appreciate."**
